title: ファイナルファンタジーIX
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
The codes of kana from the naming screen: a name entered a character at a time, its bytes read after each
Played from power-on through the first place and into the second; the script's readings compared with the lines read off 30 pictures
notes: Read by the script games/ps1/SLPS-02000.lua; there is no layout. The four discs share one boot executable. Messages lie in memory as the place's block, one byte a kana, kanji two bytes. Kanji 0xFA nn and 0xFB nn are the same everywhere; kanji from 0xFC 00 are a font of the place's own, so the script keeps them by place (SLPS-02000.places). Both lists hold only kanji read off the screen so far: the rest come out as U+FFFD. Battle messages, menus and the naming screen aren't read.
